detail.longDescription:
Make your iPhone feel more like yours. Scriptable lets you use JavaScript to create your own widgets, add to your Shortcuts, and build little tools for everyday life.

Create interactive widgets that look and work the way you want. Keep an eye on what matters to you, track your progress, or count down to something you’re looking forward to. Make them your own with colors, fonts, and layouts, then add buttons and switches to get things done with a tap, right from your Home Screen.

Scriptable works with the things you already use on your iPhone, like calendars, reminders, photos, and files. Put together a daily overview, organize your documents, or make a little tool that saves you a few steps. Take your Shortcuts further with a script that adds just what you need. You decide how it all works together.

You don’t have to start with a blank page. Browse the gallery, try a script or a widget, and change the code to make it your own. Examples and documentation are available in the app, even offline, so you can learn as you go. Keep your scripts in folders and sync them across your devices with iCloud, ready for your next idea.
